partitionNote: All three South Carolina tracks are blocked as official-form routes. The committed South Carolina evidence states that South Carolina expungements start with either the Solicitor's Office or the summary court and use the official SCCA 223-series forms. Drafting an application or order for any of these tracks would replicate SCCA 223A1 or SCCA 223B1, which is prohibited. Official-PDF overlay work belongs to lane D/E.

tracks.legalName: Solicitor Application to Destroy Arrest Records After Successful Alcohol Education Program Completion, S.C. Code § 17-22-530(A)
tracks.note: Official-form route: SCCA 223A1 application / SCCA 223B1 order. Court level not settled by § 17-22-530(B). § 17-22-550 in the authority list was not read at source.

tracks.legalName: Solicitor Application to Destroy Arrest Records After Successful Traffic Education Program Completion, S.C. Code § 17-22-330(A)
tracks.note: Blocked on two independent grounds: official-form route (SCCA 223A1/223B1), and no destruction-application subsection is established for the traffic programme — § 17-22-350 sits in the authority list but its text was not read.

tracks.legalName: Solicitor Application to Expunge Records After a First-Offence Drug Conditional Discharge, S.C. Code § 44-53-450(b)
tracks.note: Official-form route: SCCA 223A1 application / SCCA 223B1 order. Statute itself was read at source on 2026-08-06, so the block is the form route and the varying court level, not a statutory gap. Fee is source-established ($350 general sessions / $150 summary court).
